answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The onyx lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the jade is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the vault of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves.
